newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai firm caught smuggling bananas.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai firm caught smuggling bananas.

text.p: A Shanghai firm smuggled 14,700 tonnes of bananas from the Philippines to China without paying import or other taxes, the Liberation Daily said on Thursday.

Shanghai Lujinzi Food Co had made 22 illegal shipments over the last year of bananas worth 118 million yuan ($14.2 million) and evaded import and value added taxes totalling 10.94 million yuan, it said.

Working with an unnamed Taiwan company, Lujinzi forged documents showing that the bananas came from Vietnam into the southwest China region of Guangxi under a barter agreement under which taxes need not be paid, it said.
The newspaper gave no more details.
